    Accessing your account

    To access your U of I student account online, log into MyUI and select the "Accounts and Billing" card. From there, you can pay tuition, view account details, set permissions and manage your payment options securely.

    Troubleshooting common account issues

    • Do not use a mobile device or tablet, as the page typically does not display properly or at all.
    • Using Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge as your web browser works the best. Other web browsers, including Safari and Firefox, will not work.
    • Your pop-up blocker needs to be turned off in order for a new tab to open for the payment system.
    • If you pressed the back button on your browser at any time, you will be taken to a screen asking for your login and password. This login will not work. You will need to log off MyUI and log back on or reboot your computer.

    Further issues, please contact OIT at 208-885-HELP (4357).

    Account payment options

    You can pay your tuition and fees in full by cash, check, debit card, credit card or electronic bank transfer (E-Check).

    • Cash is accepted only in person at the Student Accounts/Cashier's Window.
    • Checks are accepted in person at the Student Accounts/Cashier's window or via mail.
    • Checks should be made out to Bursar, U of I
    • Debit Card payment, with a PIN #, is accepted only in person at the Student Account/Cashier's window.
    • Credit card and Debit card payment is accepted via MyUI (with a convenience fee of $3 or 3%, whichever is greater).
    • Electronic bank transfers (E-Checks) are accepted only via MyUI (no convenience fee).

    For parents

    For access to your student’s account to view or pay tuition, your student must give you access. Your student should:

    • Log into MyUI
    • Click the accounts and billing card
    • Click View Account Activity
    • Select Authorize Users to set access permissions and enter the email of the person needing access to the account. An email will be sent to the designated address outlining next steps.

    529 College Savings Plan Payments

    University of Idaho uses Backpack to receive 529 payments electronically. Backpack is free to use and allows families to securely transfer funds directly from their 529 College Savings Plan to the university. Payments are integrated with our Cashier’s Office, allowing us to receive notification as soon as a transfer is initiated.

    When families request payments through a 529 plan’s website, the funds are typically mailed as paper checks to the school. Checks can introduce delays, errors and added manual work for both families and university staff. Studies show that nearly 1 in 3 families using paper checks for tuition will face a payment issue at some point.

    To help ensure timely and accurate processing, we encourage all families using a 529 College Savings Plan to submit their tuition payments electronically through Backpack.

    How Backpack works

    1. Log into MyUI and navigate to the Accounts & Billing card to view your current account balance. Fall semester charges are typically assessed in mid-July and will be available for viewing and payment at that time. Spring and Summer semester charges will be available five days prior to the start of the semester.
    2. Click on the “MAKE A PAYMENT” button within the “Accounts and Billing” card.
    3. In the Announcement on the left side under the Backpack 529 section, click on the link labeled “Make a 529 payment here”.

      Please Note: Backpack is now available for University of Idaho families to submit 529 payments electronically. We are currently working with the vendor to integrate Backpack directly into the online payment portal. Until that implementation is complete, please use the link above to access Backpack and submit your 529 payment.
    4. Select your 529 Plan Provider and complete your Backpack account.
    5. You can now link your 529 College Savings Plan and submit payments directly to the University of Idaho.

    Payment plans

    University of Idaho offers payment plans to students unable to pay in full by the beginning of the semester or who do not have enough financial aid to cover the full balance for the semester. The payment plan requires an enrollment fee of $55 for each semester.

    • Fall semester payment plans can be set up for four monthly payments beginning in August.
    • Spring monthly payment plans can be set up for four monthly payments beginning in January.
    • Summer payment plans can be set up for four monthly payments beginning in early-May.

    Sign up for a payment plan

    To sign up for a payment plan, log into MyUI, select the "Accounts and Billing" card, click on "MAKE A PAYMENT," then select Payment Plans.

    Important payment plan details

    • Fall/Spring: You must have the payment plan set up by the first day of classes to avoid late fees from University of Idaho.
    • Summer: You must have the payment plan set up by the first Monday of your first session to avoid late fees from University of Idaho.
    • You must have at least $150 in charges to set up a payment plan.
    • A late fee of $60 is charged for payments not received by each payment plan installment due date.
    • Transcripts may be released for students without Title IV funding if they are current on their payment plan balance. Transcript holds will be placed on accounts that have an owing balance for students that have not received Title IV funding.
    • If you receive financial aid after you have set up a payment plan, the financial aid is applied to your student account balance first, and the plan installment amounts are decreased or canceled.
    • If you are delinquent on two installments on a payment plan, this can result in the plan being canceled and regular University of Idaho late payment fees will be incurred.

    Foreign payments

    International students can pay with TransferMate.

    TransferMate makes it easier and more affordable for international students to pay their fees. TransferMate allows you to make international payments to University of Idaho without paying international banking charges and you will receive a competitive foreign exchange rate.

    What are the benefits?

    • Pay in your local currency and to a local bank account
    • No international banking charges from your bank
    • Preferential exchange rates
    • Simply Pay online using credit card/APM or by bank transfer
    • 24 hour customer service support through TransferMate’s Multi-lingual support team

    If you're an international student paying fees to University of Idaho, you can use this secure, fast method to make your fee payments to us.

    Manage your student account online

    In MyUI, open the Accounts and Billing card, and click Make a Payment to view or pay your bill.

    View student accountView student account

    How TransferMate works

    1. Log into MyUI to find your account balance. Once in MyUI, go to the "Accounts and Billing" card, this will show you what your current account balance is. For Fall semester, balances will be available 10 days prior to the start of the semester. For Spring and Summer semesters, balances will be available five days prior to the start of the semester. If you make a payment prior to departure from your country, please only pay 50% of the balance. You can pay the remainder once you are at University of Idaho. If making payment prior to your charges posting, please pay up to $5,000.00 USD.
    2. Click on the “MAKE A PAYMENT” button and then on the “Make Payment” button.
    3. Select the appropriate date, term and the amount in USD ($) you wish to pay and then click the add button and then click continue.
    4. Under the “Select Payment Method” select TransferMate Intl and click continue. Select the country you are paying from and then click review rates.  Click enter details.
    5. Enter information on Student Details page and click “Continue to Confirmation”.
    6. You will then get an email with payment instructions on how to complete the payment. Once the payment is completed and validated, TransferMate will send confirmation to the university, and your student account balance will automatically be updated.

    Tax information

    The university's "Tuition Statement" (1098T’s) for 2026 will be available in MyUI under the Student Accounts menu by end of day Jan. 31, 2027.

    If you gave your consent to receive the document electronically, you will receive an email when it is ready by the end of day on Jan. 31, 2027. If electronic consent is not received by Jan. 6, 2027, the 1098-T will be mailed on Jan. 31, 2027 to the permanent address on file listed as of Jan. 6, 2027.

    For more information about Form 1098-T, visit irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1098t.pdf.

    Education tax credits

    Depending on your income (or your family’s income, if you are a dependent), whether you were considered full or half-time enrolled, and the amount of your qualified educational expenses for the year, you may be eligible for a federal education tax credit. (You can find detailed information about claiming education tax credits in IRS Publication 970, page 9.)

    The dollar amounts reported on your Form 1098-T may assist you in completing IRS Form 8863 – the form used for calculating the education tax credits that a taxpayer may claim as part of your tax return.

    Tax help

    University of Idaho is unable to provide you with individual tax advice, but should you have questions, you should seek the counsel of an informed tax preparer or adviser.

    If you have any questions about the 1098-T, please visit the ECSI Tax Documents Help page for general information. If you have any further questions, please contact the Student Accounts office at 208-885-7447.
